notes.title: Update 1.0.8 — Balance tweaks, QoL improvements, and Japanese localization!
notes.content:
[h1]Hey survivors![/h1]
[h3]Today’s update brings improvements to game balance and overall experience:[/h3]

[h3]🛠 Fixes & Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug with item stacking in the inventory — everything should now work as expected.
[*] Armor has been nerfed — it no longer makes you invincible.
[*] Added the ability to quickly transfer items with a single click using the middle mouse button. 
[*] Melee combat simplified: no more need to aim, attacks now go in the correct direction automatically.
[*] Fixed localization issues — some text was not being displayed in the selected language.
[/list]
[h3]🌍 New[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added full Japanese localization — ようこそ!
[/list]
[h3]🧩 Misc[/h3]
[list]
[*] Minor UI fixes and improvements.
[/list]
[b]Thanks for playing and helping us make the game better! ❤️[/b]
